title: Healthcare Workforce Demand Forecasting by Unit

blueprintSignals.name: Acuity-weighted workload
blueprintSignals.definition: sum of acuity scores times expected hours of care per patient-day
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Use the acuity score as charted at forecast time

blueprintSignals.name: Planned procedure load
blueprintSignals.definition: scheduled cases by service line and day with historical conversion to inpatient stays
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Use the schedule snapshot as it stood at forecast time, not the cases that finally happened

blueprintSignals.name: Admission and discharge rhythm
blueprintSignals.definition: day-of-week and hour-of-day arrival and discharge profile per unit
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Compute from event time not from the processing time of the feed

blueprintSignals.name: Holiday and event calendar
blueprintSignals.definition: distance to the nearest holiday and local event windows
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Only calendars published before the forecast date

engineFeatures.meaning: mean of the last 7 and 28 days and their ratio, known at the forecast origin
values on the same weekday in previous weeks
what is already booked or ordered for the target day at the origin
promotion and external-signal flags for the target day, as published at the origin
how many of the recent days are missing in the feed

label: For "Healthcare Workforce Demand Forecasting by Unit": Forecast role- and skill-specific staffing demand for every facility, unit and shift so leaders can plan rosters and contingency cover days or weeks ahead instead of discovering shortfalls at shift start. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training on paid hours that reflect past shortages.
